title: Siege of Dongnae
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Dongnae", at revision 1370740786, opens: "The siege of Dongnae was a siege that occurred on May 25, 1592 during the 1592–1598 Japanese invasions of Korea. It resulted in the capture by Japanese forces of Dongnaeeupseong, a mountain fortress on the way to Hanseong (Seoul)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q497348, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1592 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
